description: Road and Speed Data is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. The Open Data Hub has numerous data relating to roads and speed, whether it be the Sydney Region Carriageway, the Tolls on our NSW roads, or the speed zones and speed camera locations. Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are Lights, Motorway, NSW Roads, NorthConnex, Road Map. The portal shows 2025-06-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
